name: A-Zenith Home Furnishings Co., Ltd.
summary: Based in Shanghai, China, A-Zenith Home Furnishings Co., Ltd. has been supplying a comprehensive range of furniture products across China since its founding in 2000. The company offers an extensive selection of household items, including furnishings for living rooms, dining areas, studies, and bedrooms, alongside decorative pieces. Beyond manufacturing, A-Zenith also provides interior design and furniture maintenance services. The firm officially changed its name from A-Zenith Furniture Co., Ltd. to its current designation in April 2017.
